title: Control Room Python/UI bootstrap
purpose: Resolve canonical Python 3.12 environment, repair dependencies if required, and start Streamlit Control Room without making runtime-render claims from source startup alone.

transitions.action: Resolve/create MAX venv and dependency state
Fail closed on missing/unrepairable canonical environment

invariants: Successful process start is not browser/UI E2E PASS.
UI does not create domain authority.
failure_behavior: Bootstrap or dependency failure stops launch with explicit diagnostics.
restart_behavior: Subsequent launch reuses verified environment when compatible.
rollback_behavior: Environment/bootstrap failure does not mutate research/Champion authority.
